title: Terraform structural grounding receipt
description: The canonical, credential-redacting RECEIPT a Terraform structural grounding query (lookup_declaration / resolve_reference) emits alongside its three-valued grounding evidence (REB-640, slice forcible-diminished-lamb). It records the provenance of the query — the normalized query, the bounded snapshot + module content digests, the parser/analyzer backend and its config digest, the enforced limits, the outcome, the generic + closed structured reason, and a result digest — so a verifier can reproduce and check the answer WITHOUT re-parsing. It carries only safe classes, hashes, and repo-relative locations: NEVER credentials, attribute literal values, or `default` values. Closed (`additionalProperties: false`) at every level, validated directly via schemas.validator('terraform_grounding_receipt').

operation.description: Which per-call session operation produced this receipt.

reason_detail.description: The CLOSED, sub-reason detail for an abstention (null for a refuted outcome). Paired one-to-one with the generic evidence `reason` via the slice's abstention-translation table.

backend.description: The parser/analyzer backend that produced this receipt and its configuration digest.

parser.description: The HCL parser library, always `python-hcl2` in this slice.

limits.description: The bounds enforced before any fact was returned (module / file / byte / timeout).

query.description: The NORMALIZED query (repo-relative POSIX paths, trimmed/canonical address or reference). Structural keys only — never literal attribute values.

outcome.description: The three-valued grounding outcome, restricted to the two a refutation-only Terraform query can emit: `refuted` (a real declaration disproves an asserted absence) or `abstain` (a closed reason). Never `match`, never an asserted absence.

reason.description: The GENERIC grounding abstention reason (mirrors grounding.schema.json's closed enum); null for a refuted outcome.
